findings.quote: The number hit this morning and the first desk reads are still landing.
findings.why: The economic calendar lists ISM Manufacturing PMI at 2026-09-01 10:00 EDT under events STILL UPCOMING with no actual value, and the live-data block is timestamped 09:37 EDT, so the release had not yet happened and no desk reactions to it exist in the context.
findings.fix: Write it as a release still to come at 10:00 ET rather than a print that has already landed.

findings.quote: The 10-year Treasury yield closed Friday at 4.75%
findings.why: Deutsche Bank ties the 4.75% highest-since-January-2025 level to yesterday's close (Monday 31 August), and the Monday-morning Goldman notes put the post-Friday 10-year at 4.71%-4.72%.
The Deutsche Bank note carrying the 36%/58%/67% sequence is published 2026-09-01 and reads '67% this morning', i.e. Tuesday morning, not Monday.

findings.quote: Goldman's own expression is September $SPY calls funded against a November put whose strike is set by where the index runs to rather than by where it trades today.
findings.why: The Goldman flow-of-funds note lists 'SPY 18Sep26 780 Calls' and 'SPX 20Nov26 95.0% Lookback Put' as two separate standalone recommendations, never as one structure where the calls are funded by the put.
findings.fix: Present them as two separate Goldman trades rather than a single funded structure.
